title: Estetla Mixtec
text: Varieties of Peñoles Mixtec, including Estetla, are spoken by approximately 13,000 people as a first language (as of 2000), reflecting its stable status within indigenous linguistic contexts despite broader pressures on Mixtec languages.[1][2][3] Linguistically, Estetla Mixtec exhibits characteristic features of the Mixtec group, including a verb-subject-object word order and a tonal system with underlying high (H) and low (L) tones that interact through complex phonological rules such as tone sandhi and floating tones.
